name: Sagar Bera
headline: Software engineer focused on production-grade web systems.
bio: I design and ship full-stack products with TypeScript, Next.js, and clear domain boundaries. I care about maintainable structure, typed contracts, and interfaces that stay out of the way.

experience.summary: Migrated the existing limited customizable Drupal based website to a fully customizable performant web app with MERN stack. Followed MVC architecture and shipped very fast.

After the successful migration, I was promoted to a full stack developer role. I was responsible for developing the new features and fixing the bugs. I also helped designing the archetecture and the codebase of Frontend as well. Implemented Hexagonal Architecture which increased the maintainability and readability of the codebase. I have implemented the CI/CD pipeline for the project using Github Actions(Self Hosted in AWS).

BuidlersTribe rebranded as RabbleLabs where We started building crypto native chat app(which involved crypto payments by telegram usernames) on top on Telegram. Also we created automated yeild generating system named 'Rabots' and I was responsible for the backend development and infrastructure setup. I have implemented the CI/CD pipeline for the project using Github Actions(Self Hosted in GCP).

By the side of RabbleLabs, I started working on a new project called 'ScribbleDao', idea was to increase visibility of new brands. Scribblers writes threads aobut brands, and brands launches campaigns, Did initial system design,DB schema design, e2e testing. Harness AI power and shiped 1week deadline feature in just 1day
